#en: Down here the city's glow turns to a damp, electric haze, and every rusted mech frame and jury-rigged servo hums with stolen power. If Vector wanted to hide his numbers inside hardware, this is where the trail would surface: in off-the-books repair jobs, "upgrades" that quietly rewrite flight logic, and half-remembered sightings of a ghost technician tweaking guidance cores for drink money. The only way to separate rumor from math is to strip these machines back to their bare vectors and see whose hand tuned them. So far I have a forgotten dataslate on a backworld, a crooked orbital buoy, and freight captains in Gagarin who insist their ships turned away from something in the dark that no official log will admit was ever there.
zh: 在这下面，城市的辉光变成一层潮湿的电气雾霭，每一具锈蚀的机甲框架与勉强拼凑的伺服都在因偷来的电力嗡鸣。若"向量"想把他的数字藏进硬件里，线索就会在这里浮出：在账外维修活儿里、在悄悄改写飞行逻辑的"升级"里，以及在半模糊的记忆中对一名为酒钱调校制导核心的幽灵技师的目击。把传闻与数学分开的唯一办法，就是把这些机器剥回到赤裸的向量，看看是谁的手调校了它们。目前为止，我有一穷乡星上被遗忘的数据板、一座歪斜的轨道浮标，以及加加林星上那些坚称自己的船在黑暗中避开了某个官方日志绝不承认存在之物的货船船长。

#en: Behind the glass and chrome of Ryujin's tower, the real memories are kept in air-gapped corners and mislabeled archives, where no quarterly report ever reaches. If anyone in Neon has a record of which ships vanished on impossible shortcuts and which executives signed off on those quiet contracts, it is buried in this building's forgotten copies, not out in any spacer bar. To follow the trail further, the paper ghosts have to be forced into the light. So far all I have are fragments: a stray dataslate in the back country, nervous denials in a corporate office, and a cutter's corrupted logs that all point to the same kind of route, the same missing name, and a pattern of "oversights" that feels too deliberate to be simple neglect.
zh: 在龙神大楼的玻璃与铬合金之后，真正的记忆被保存在物理隔离的角落与标签错乱的档案库里，那里是任何季度报告都到不了的地方。若霓虹城里有谁记录着哪些船在不可能的捷径上消失、哪些高管签过那些安静的合同，那它就埋在这栋楼被遗忘的副本里，而不在任何太空劫匪的酒吧里。要把这条线索追下去，这些纸上的幽灵必须被逼到光下。目前为止我只有碎片：乡间一块散落数据板、某间公司办公室里紧张的否认，以及一艘切割船损坏的日志——它们都指向同一种航线、同一个失踪的名字，以及一种"疏忽"的模式，感觉太过刻意，不像是单纯的不上心。

#en: The farm looks harmless from orbit, just another patch of soil and machinery clinging to a thin margin in Freestar space, but the traffic patterns tell a different story. Haulers that never show on public ledgers keep dropping in after dark, and local talk drops to a murmur whenever someone mentions certain cargo manifests. Whatever path the salvager is carving through war wrecks and abandoned yards, the records tying it together were hidden where nobody expects more than grain and root vegetables. So far, all anyone will admit is this: a stray slate out in the black mentioned a missing tug, that tug's markings turned up on scrap buried in a field, and every whisper since has circled the same shipbreaker's name in hushed voices.
zh: 这座农场从轨道上看人畜无害，不过是自由星系联盟星域边缘又一片依附着薄薄一隅的土壤与机械，可交通模式讲的却是另一回事。从不出现在公开账册上的货船不断在入夜后降落，只要有人提起某些货物舱单，本地的谈话就会低成一片呢喃。无论那名打捞者在战争残骸与废弃场区之间刻出的是一条什么路径，把它们串起来的记录，都被藏在了没人指望除了谷物和根茎蔬菜之外还有别的东西的地方。目前为止，所有人愿意承认的只有这些：漆黑太空中一块散落数据板提到一艘失踪的拖船，那艘拖船的标记出现在田里埋着的废料上，而此后每一句低语，都用压低的声音绕着同一个拆船人的名字打转。

#en: Out on the moon's dark side, the cargo relay hangs just far enough from the lanes that nobody asks why manifests never quite match the traffic. This is where hearsay hardens into evidence, where a fence who swears he only moves scrap just happens to handle the same sealed containers that keep turning up in frontier crises. Every dockhand here has a different version of the story about a quiet Scotsman routing lifelines and ghosts through unlogged bays, the tale growing taller each time it changes mouths. So far, all you have are a lost dataslate, an overfed harvest that should have failed, and a ledger from a dead farm that sketched a hidden spine through the Settled Systems, every segment marked with his patient, practiced hand.
zh: 在卫星阴暗的那一面，那座货运中继悬得离航道刚好足够远，没人会追问为什么舱单总与交通对不上。这里正是道听途说硬化成证据的地方，一个发誓只倒卖废料的销赃商，偏偏经手的正是那些不断出现在边境危机中的同款密封货柜。这里的每个码头工都有一套不同的版本，讲一个沉默的苏格兰人如何把生命线与幽灵送过未登记的货舱，故事每换一张嘴就长高一分。目前为止，你只有一块丢失的数据板、一场本该失败却产量过剩的收成，以及一份来自死掉农场的账册——它勾勒出一条穿越定居星系的隐藏脊柱，每一段都标着他那种耐心而熟练的手笔。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the numbers stopped adding up and nobody bothered to ask why. Old tug parts, refitted grav-drives, and forgotten cargo records all passed through here, each slightly mistranscribed, mistimed, or misfiled until the errors formed a corridor only one pilot knew how to read. Whatever is hidden among these refurbished hulls and corporate refurb shops is the translation key that turns those scattered mistakes into a deliberate route, the next bend in her invisible lane. So far the trail is stitched from chance and oversight: a mislaid dataslate in the back of beyond, incomplete logs from a quiet lab, and a relay that repeated the wrong traffic just long enough for someone like her to disappear between the lines.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是那些数字不再对得上、而没人费心问为什么的地方。旧拖船零件、改装的引力引擎与被遗忘的货运记录都从这里经过，每一件都被轻微地误抄、误时或错误归档，直到这些错误形成了一条只有一名飞行员才懂得如何阅读的走廊。藏在这些翻新船壳与公司翻新铺子之间的东西，就是那把把零散错误译成刻意航线的钥匙，是她那条隐形航道上的下一个弯。目前为止，这条线索是由偶然与疏忽缝成的：天涯之外一块放错位置的数据板、一座安静实验室里残缺的日志，以及一座把错误交通重复到刚好足够她那样的人消失在字里行间的时长。

#en: The asteroid field is the only place this fragment could survive unnoticed, tucked between dead rock and background noise, its signal warped by drifting stone and old collision scars. Whoever seeded it here understood Grav Drive telemetry and how to hide a map inside the static, counting on distance and radiation to erase the last trace of a forbidden pattern. But stone shifts, sensors grow sharper, and whispers about a missing pilot and a lost experiment have pulled too many eyes toward these broken orbits to ignore. So far the trail runs like this scattered data in a forgotten system, a hushed exchange above a quiet colony, and the growing suspicion that all those grav spikes and redacted logs are pieces of one long erased jump.
zh: 这片小行星带，是这块碎片唯一能在无人注意中存活的地方：夹在死岩石与背景噪声之间，信号被漂移的石块与旧碰撞伤疤扭歪。把它播在这里的人懂引力引擎遥测，也懂得如何把地图藏进静电里，指望距离与辐射抹掉一个被禁模式的最后痕迹。可石头会移动，传感器会变敏锐，而关于一名失踪飞行员与一次丢失实验的低语，已经把这些破碎轨道拉进了太多无法忽视的视线。目前为止，这条线索是这样的：某个被遗忘星系里的零散数据、某座安静殖民地上空压低声音的交谈，以及一种越来越强的怀疑——所有那些引力尖峰与涂黑日志，都是一次早已被抹除的长跃迁的碎片。

#en: Out here the orbit is wrong in ways the charts do not admit, a thin ring of wrecks and cold buoys bent around a single, precise disturbance in the dark. Whatever she has been testing, this is where the pattern tightens, where a harmless calibration rig became the quiet heart of a new lane that threads between patrols and trade alike. Left alone, it settles into routine, just another invisible shortcut baked into the habits of smugglers and frightened settlers until no one remembers who first drew it. The trail so far runs from a cramped Freestar trailer stacked with nervous Ranger notes to a scarred sensor buoy replaying the convoy's last seconds, each record showing her math slowly migrating from sanctioned grids into the shadows.
zh: 在这里，这条轨道以星图不肯承认的方式出了错：一圈由残骸与冰冷浮标构成的细环，弯折于黑暗中一处孤零零而精确的扰动周围。无论她一直在测试什么，这里正是模式收得最紧的地方——一台无害的校准设备成了某条新航道的安静心脏，那条航道穿行于巡逻队与贸易船之间。任其自生自灭，它就会沉淀为例行惯例，成为又一则隐形捷径，被烤进走私者与惊惶定居者的习惯里，直到没人记得是谁先画下它。目前为止，线索从一辆塞满游骑兵紧张笔记的拥挤自由星系联盟拖车，延伸到一枚反复重放车队最后几秒的伤痕累累的传感器浮标，每一份记录都显示她的数学正慢慢从获批的网格迁入阴影。

#en: Out here in the dark, where a GalBank protection ship drifts without escort or explanation, numbers mean more than guns; this is where the quiet decisions that starved or saved whole colonies were recorded before someone tried to erase them by losing the entire vault to deep orbit. The GA-2267 Securehaul was never meant to be a tomb, just a moving firewall between investors and risk, but a slow accretion of pressure, audits, and off-the-books riders turned it into the only place the unedited story still lives. Back in the factories and docks you found scorched manifests and uneasy inspectors in Gagarin, each hinting that freight routes, loan terms, and crop failures were not accidents but the first visible seams in a larger design.
zh: 在这片黑暗里，一艘盖尔银行护航船无护航、无解释地漂着，在这里数字比枪炮更有分量；正是在这里，那些饿死或救活整片殖民地的安静决定被记录了下来，之后才有人试图通过把整座金库丢进深空来抹掉它们。"GA-2267 安全运输"从来不该是一座坟墓，只是投资者与风险之间一道移动的防火墙，可压力、审计与账外附加条款的缓慢积累，把它变成了未删改故事唯一还活着的地方。回到工厂与码头，你在加加林星发现了烧焦的舱单与不安的检查员，每一处都暗示：货运航线、贷款条款与作物歉收都不是意外，而是一场更大设计中最初可见的裂缝。

#en: Out here, suspended between a dead black sky and the thin glow of another struggling world, nobody can look away or pretend not to see the pattern.  \nOnly an orbital trail record can show how often his work brushes past the same colonies, how many times a maintenance shuttle lingers just long enough to rewrite a forecast before vanishing into deep transit lanes.  \nPlanetside, mechanics mutter into their cups and supervisors suddenly find urgent business elsewhere when his name drifts through conversation, but the telemetry does not avert its gaze; from the outpost logs, the courier manifests, and the doctored garage readouts, the same masked flight profile keeps surfacing, tying his movements to every quiet failure on the frontier.
zh: 在这里，悬在死寂的黑色天空与另一颗挣扎世界的微弱辉光之间，没人能移开视线或假装看不见这个模式。  \n只有一份轨道轨迹记录能显示，他的工作在同样的殖民地旁擦过多少次，一艘维护穿梭机又有多少次恰好停留到足以改写一份预报、然后消失进深空运输航道。  \n在地面上，机械师对着杯子嘟囔，而只要他的名字在谈话中飘过，主管们就突然发现别处有急事，可遥测不会移开目光；从前哨日志、信使舱单到被做手脚的车库读数，同一个被遮掩的飞行轮廓不断浮现，把他的行踪与边境上每一次悄无声息的失败系在一起。

#en: This forgotten listening post is where old signals go to be ignored, which is exactly why someone chose it as a dead letterbox. Its orbit is decayed but stable, too cheap to deorbit, too minor to reclaim, so it just hangs here with its dishes half-locked, catching echoes no one is supposed to see. Whoever has been bending the lanes needed a place like this, a station with a reputation for holding on to hardware, logs, and assignments long after the budget said they should be gone. So far, the trail is thin but real: a scorched dataslate in a backwater shed talking about unsafe drones, and now this derelict node, its power draw just a little too high and its receivers pointed a few degrees off where any honest relay would be listening.
zh: 这座被遗忘的听音哨，是旧信号前去被忽视的地方，这正是有人把它选作死信箱的原因。它的轨道已衰减但稳定，脱轨太费钱、回收又太微不足道，所以它就这么挂着，天线盘半锁着，捕捉没人该看到的回声。一直在掰弯航道的那个人需要这样的地方——一座以"在预算说它们该消失之后仍长期保留硬件、日志与任务"而闻名的星际站。目前为止，这条线索稀薄却真实：一座穷乡棚屋里一块烧焦的数据板在谈论不安全的无人机，以及如今这个废弃节点——它的耗电略高了一点点，接收器偏离了任何诚实中继会聆听的方向几度。

#en: This place is where the lines cross, where an old civilian shell fronts for an autonomous plant whose guidance code has been rewritten so many times it hums like a choir of ghosts; if the heart of it keeps beating, more ships will drift into carefully shaped funerals and no one will ever prove why. Word is Outcast Detail are inside, guarding something they swear is just another black job for a faceless handler, and every tech, merc, and clerk who mentions it insists they heard it from someone else first, like the rumor is walking on its own. So far the trail has been a relay that talked after it died, a gutted merc post with doctored beacons, and scattered logs all mapping back toward one engineer who never stopped cleaning up the war.
zh: 这地方正是线条交汇之处：一层旧民用外壳之下，是一座自主工厂，它的制导代码被改写过太多次，嗡鸣得像一支幽灵合唱团；只要它的心脏仍在跳动，就会有更多船只漂进精心塑形的葬礼，而永远没人能证明原因。据说被逐分队就在里面，守着他们发誓只是又一桩替无名雇主干的黑活的东西；每一个提起此事的技师、佣兵和文书都坚称自己是先从别人那里听来的，仿佛这则传闻在自行走路。目前为止，这条线索是一座死后仍在说话的中继、一处带着被做手脚信标的被掏空佣兵据点，以及散落各处的日志——它们全都映射回同一名从未停止清理这场战争的工程师。

#en: Out here the Helium-3 stacks are more than fuel; they are leverage on every ship that dares to jump through this sector, and he has tied the plant's grav regulators into a single twitch of his hand. The towers hum at the edge of harmonic failure, pressure alarms ghosting through the metal like distant thunder, promising that one wrong surge will light the sky and scrub every trace of his work. Cutting him off here means severing his last, dirtiest lane before it ripples across trade routes and warfronts alike. We traced his pattern from a corrupted beacon in the rocks to a Freestar hulk gutted by overstrained drives, each log whispering the same careful handwriting and the same missing seconds nobody in the reports wanted to talk about.
zh: 在这里，那些氦-3 储罐不只是燃料；它们是对每一艘胆敢跃迁穿越这片星域的船只的杠杆，而他已把这座设施的引力调节器系在自己手部的一次抽动上。那些塔在谐波失效的边缘嗡鸣，压力警报像远处闷雷一样在金属里游荡，预示着一次错误的浪涌就会点亮天空、抹掉他工作的每一丝痕迹。在这里切断他，意味着在他最后一条、也是最肮脏的航道扩散到贸易航线与战线之前把它截断。我们追着他的模式从岩石间一座损坏的信标，追到一艘被超负荷引擎掏空内部的自由星系联盟残骸，每一份日志都低语着同样谨慎的笔迹，以及报告里没人愿意谈起的同样几秒空缺。

#en: All the trajectories converge on this tower. Its upper labs once modeled grav behavior for the core worlds, the sort of place Vector audited before the numbers were softened and the warnings buried. Whatever she left behind to point the way will be encoded in work no one outside a handful of specialists even understands, which is exactly why a rogue unit like the Sundered Commandos was sent to lock it down. They argue in low voices about whose orders they are really following, but never loud enough to force a line in the sand. So far the trail shows only fragments: a stray dataslate on a backworld, a gutted satellite in orbit, redacted files pried from a quiet annex, and now a pattern of erased research that all traces back to her hand.
zh: 所有的轨迹都汇聚到这座塔上。它的上层实验室曾为核心世界模拟引力行为，正是"向量"在数字被软化、警告被掩埋之前审计过的那类地方。她留下来指路的东西，会被编码在只有少数专家才看得懂的工作里——这正是像断裂突击队这样一支失控单位被派来封锁它的原因。他们低声争论自己到底在听谁的命令，但从来不够大声，没人敢划下那条线。目前为止，这条线索只有碎片：一穷乡星上一块散落数据板、轨道上一颗被掏空的卫星、从一个安静附属机构撬出来的涂黑文件，以及如今一种被抹除的研究模式——全都追溯回她的手。

#en: Out here, far from any lane that shows on public charts, the beacon hangs alone in the dark, singing corrections into empty space. This is where her work stops pretending to be an accident; every pulse carries a tiny shove, enough to bend traffic away from patrols and toward whatever quiet corridor she favors next. Intercepting that song here, at its source, is the only way to see which horizon she is steering toward before the route hardens into habit and rumor. So far the trail has run from a forgotten outpost, to a faulty orbital transmitter, to a drifting vault ship full of misaligned logs, each step recorded in half-phrases and careful omissions, like everyone hearing the same story but quietly agreeing not to repeat certain parts.
zh: 在这里，远离任何出现在公开星图上的航道，那座信标孤悬于黑暗中，朝空荡太空唱着修正。这里正是她的工作不再假装是意外的地方；每一记脉冲都带着一次微小的推搡，足以把交通掰离巡逻队，转向她下一个中意的安静走廊。在源头处拦截那首歌，是看清她正朝哪片地平线转向的唯一办法——赶在这条航线硬化成习惯与传闻之前。目前为止，线索从一座被遗忘的前哨，到一台故障的轨道发射机，再到一艘塞满错位日志的漂移金库船，每一步都记在半截话与谨慎的省略里，仿佛所有人听着同一个故事，却悄悄约定不重复其中某些部分。

#en: The ground around this quiet settlement still remembers what no one here will describe. Soil meant for crops has been fused and pitted in a rough circle, as if something far heavier than any farm shuttle bled its wake across the homestead and left in a tearing hurry. This is the only place where scorch, strange gravity scars, and a frontier community's sudden silence overlap, where whatever was offloaded or hidden would have brushed against ordinary lives before vanishing back into the lanes. So far the trail is a half erased sensor reading over an empty world, a frightened story told in orbit about a ship that never showed on scopes, and the way every local here talks around the night their sky hummed and nobody was supposed to see it.
zh: 这座安静定居点周围的土地，仍记得这里没人愿意描述的事情。本用于种作物的土壤被熔结、被凿出坑洞，围成一个粗略的圆，仿佛某个远比任何农用穿梭机沉重的东西拖着尾迹划过这片农庄、然后仓皇离去。这是唯一一处灼痕、古怪的引力伤疤与一个边境社群突然的沉默相互重叠的地方——无论当初卸下或藏起的是什么，它都曾擦过平凡的生活，然后消失回航道之中。目前为止，这条线索是一段悬在空荡世界上方被半擦除的传感器读数、一个在轨道上讲起的关于一艘从未出现在示波器上的船的惊恐故事，以及这里每个当地人如何绕着那一晚说话——那晚他们的天空嗡鸣过，而没人该看见它。

#en: It had to be this hulk, drifting where GalBank's clean ledgers cannot follow. The vault-ship is a dead node in Vector's geometry, a place he once trusted to lock away the trajectories that no board wanted on record. Its armored data holds the pattern of every quiet satellite nudge, every storm band moved a fraction off true, and past disputes over flood claims and failed harvests left faint administrative scars in its archives that guided those files here like silt in a current. Back on the fringe station and that abandoned listening post, we saw only corrupted pings and denied payouts; out at the lonely rendezvous in deep space, the trail sharpened into altered beacons and GalBank codes all pointing toward the same unseen hand in orbit.
zh: 必须是这具残骸——漂在盖尔银行干净的账册追不到的地方。那艘金库船是"向量"几何里一个死掉的节点，一处他曾经信任、用来锁住那些没有任何董事会愿意留档的轨迹的地方。它装甲保护的数据里存着每一次安静的卫星轻推、每一条被推离真实一丝的风暴带的模式；而过去关于洪水索赔与歉收的争执，在它的档案里留下淡淡的行政伤疤，那些伤疤像水流中的淤泥一样把这些文件引到了这里。回到边境星际站与那座废弃的听音哨，我们只看到损坏的脉冲与被拒绝的赔付；而在深空那场孤独的会合点，线索锐化成被改动的信标与盖尔银行代码——全都指向轨道上同一只看不见的手。

#en: PX-7708 hangs where the grav shear first bit through its hull, a dead weight on the edge of a corridor no sane pilot should have used once, let alone mapped. Whatever hand overrode Navy protocols and walked this ship into the teeth of the storm left its trail in the guidance banks and nav records no one has dared to sanitize. Out here, away from tribunals and insurance hearings, you can read those scars without filters, see whether a human navigator has been writing new rules for who lives and who vanishes. So far, the trail runs from a frozen lab full of twisted beacons to whispers about migrant convoys and quiet payments routed through Trade Authority shells, each step pointing to the same calm voice that treats storms like safe harbor.
zh: PX-7708悬在引力剪切最初咬穿它船壳的地方，是某条任何理智飞行员都不该用过一次、更别提测绘过的走廊边缘上的一坨死重。无论是什么手覆写了海军的协议、把这条船开进风暴的利齿，它都在制导库与导航记录里留下了痕迹——那些没人敢去清理的记录。在这里，远离法庭与保险听证会，你可以不加滤镜地读出那些伤疤，看是否有个人类领航员一直在为"谁活谁消失"写下新规则。目前为止，线索从一座塞满扭曲信标的冰封实验室，延伸到关于移民车队与经由贸易管理局空壳走账的安静付款的低语，每一步都指向同一个平静的声音——它把风暴当成避风港。

#en: Whatever was being tested here was never meant to see daylight, which is why it has to be erased in the same dead corridors where it was born. The outpost is long since emptied of researchers, but not of watchers; the Lima Devils haunt its halls now, treating the silent labs like inherited turf, guarding something they probably do not fully understand. Schedules here slipped years ago, one shortcut at a time, until dangerous work became just another box to tick and nobody noticed when the rules stopped matching the practice. So far I have followed a trail from a forgotten cache in the wilds to a derelict archive, then here, where the first proof that someone rewrote the frontier's soil was locked away and quietly folded into gang business.
zh: 在这里被测试的东西，从来就不该见到天日，所以它必须在它诞生的同一条死走廊里被抹掉。这座前哨的研究人员早已撤空，但监视者没有；利马恶魔如今出没于它的走廊，把那些沉默的实验室当成继承来的地盘，守着一些他们大概并不完全理解的东西。这里的日程多年前就一格一格地滑脱，一次抄近路接着一次，直到危险的工作变成又一个待勾选的方框，而没人注意到规则何时不再与实际相符。目前为止，我追着线索从荒野中一处被遗忘的储藏点，到一座废弃档案库，再到这里——"有人改写了边境的土壤"的最初证据，正是被锁在这里、并被悄悄折进帮派生意里的。

#en: Rumors at the edge of the system say the array has been watching longer than any survey charter, listening from just beyond where the charts grow thin. Some swear it caught a colony dying in real time, others whisper it tracks a single ship that never pings transponders the same way twice. What it actually recorded will show which empty lanes he trusts when he slips past LIST and Argos eyes, and where those lanes bend toward something no one wants to put in writing. So far, every fragment I have pulled points to poisoned settlements, scrubbed cargo approvals, and maintenance ghosts in Neon's underbelly, all circling one surveyor who understands that people will believe any story about the frontier except the one that blames their own hunger.
zh: 星系边缘的传闻说，那座阵列比任何勘探许可观测得都久，从星图开始变稀薄之处之外聆听。有人发誓它实时捕捉到一座殖民地死去，另一些则低语说它追踪着一艘从不以同样方式两次发出应答器讯号的船。它实际记录下的东西，会显示他在溜过独立盟与阿戈斯的眼皮时信任哪些空荡航道，以及那些航道在哪里弯向某个没人愿意写下来的东西。目前为止，我拉出的每一块碎片都指向被下毒的定居点、被擦净的货物审批，以及霓虹城下腹的维护幽灵，全都绕着一个勘探员打转——他明白，人们会相信任何关于边境的故事，除了那个把矛头指向他们自己饥饿的故事。

#en: OM-2098 rides dark in its patrol arc, a UC SysDef hulk still broadcasting clean credentials while whole decks hang half-powered and uninspected. If there was ever a place for something to pass quietly under the Navy's nose, it is here, buried in an overworked command net that trusts its own transponders more than its crew. The same culture that treated tug hands as expendable let this ship become a blind spot, and that blind spot is where the numbers on Rivet's trail finally align with official records and the people who doctored them. So far, the path runs from a forgotten rock and a discarded slate to scattered yard rumors, a grieving family's recording, and a Trade Authority broker who remembered the wrong pilot asking the right questions.
zh: OM-2098在其巡逻弧线上黑暗地巡航，一具联殖星防队的船壳，仍在广播着干净的身份凭证，而整层整层的甲板却半功率、未经检查地悬着。若说有什么地方能让某物悄悄从海军的鼻子底下通过，那就是这里——藏在张过度劳累、信任自家应答器甚于信任船员的指挥网里。正是那种把拖船工当成可消耗品的文化，让这艘船变成了盲点；而那个盲点，正是"铆钉"线索上的数字终于与官方记录、以及与那些涂改它们的人对齐的地方。目前为止，这条路从一块被遗忘的岩石与一块被丢弃的数据板，延伸到零散的船坞传闻、一段悲痛家属的录音，以及一名记得"错误"飞行员问过正确问题的贸易管理局掮客。

#en: The KN-4320 drifts under bruised starlight, its hull lights dead, its transponder still whispering UC SysDef credentials that no one has questioned in far too long. Out here, away from patrol lanes and busy grav wells, the silence around a sanctioned tactical ship is its own alarm. Whatever was pulled from investigation archives and routed through this frame was meant to stay buried in an empty sector, where Vector's experiments and the system's embarrassment could coexist unnoticed. A forgotten dataslate in the frontier, a nervous clerk's mismatched permits, and telemetry leaks from an old simulator all say the same thing: someone has been reshaping official routes with outlaw math, and command let the signs float out here, unseen, for years.
zh: KN-4320在淤青般的星光下漂着，船壳灯光熄灭，应答器仍在低声念叨着联殖星防队的身份凭证——太久没人质疑过它们了。在这里，远离巡逻航道与繁忙的引力井，一艘受认可战术舰周围的沉默本身就是警报。凡是从调查档案里抽出、经这具船体转运的东西，都被打算留在空旷星区里埋着——在那里，"向量"的实验与体制的难堪可以互不打扰地共存。边境一块被遗忘的数据板、一名紧张文书对不上的许可证，以及一台旧模拟器的遥测泄漏，都在说同一件事：有人一直在用法外之徒的数学重塑官方航线，而指挥部让这些迹象在此处无人看见地漂了许多年。

#en: Up here the city peels away, leaving only steel bones, humming relays, and the crackle of the Conduction Grid clawing at the sky. This is where she can stand above every antenna and uplink in Neon, splice her signal into Ryujin feeds and Trade Authority channels at once, and loose years of stolen memories before anyone can cut the power. Winds carry the ozone stink of overworked capacitors, and every flash of lightning across the span could be another packet of truth or another lie set in stone. You chased her trail from a buried dataslate in the dust, to quiet questions in Neon's heart, to a courier drifting cold in the dark; each step showed the same ghost signature, the same careful edits, and faces that remembered just enough to be afraid.
zh: 在这上面，城市层层剥落，只剩下钢铁骨架、嗡鸣的中继，以及抓挠天空的"输电网格"的噼啪声。正是在这里，她能站在霓虹城每一根天线与上行链路之上，把自己的信号同时接进龙神的传输流与贸易管理局的信道，在任何人切断电力之前放出多年偷来的记忆。风里带着过载电容器那股臭氧味，而横贯桥架的每一次闪电都可能又是一包真相、或又一个被钉死的谎言。你追着她的痕迹，从尘土里一块被埋的数据板，到霓虹城心脏地带安静的提问，再到一艘在黑暗中冷寂漂着的信使船；每一步都显示出同一个幽灵签名、同样谨慎的编辑，以及那些记得刚好够多、以至于害怕的脸。
